name: FFmpeg Image Toolkit
description: An image toolkit that applies image styles to animated GIFs/PNGs by shelling out to the ffmpeg binary. SECURITY: Ffmpeg::execute() runs exec() on a shell string that embeds the source file's realpath double-quoted, with a blocklist that misses backtick/$()/quote — a crafted source FILENAME can inject commands (RCE) when the FFmpeg toolkit is selected. Prefer argv/escapeshellarg.
